osm_tags.description: Fishing Boat Wreck on the south west corner of Sozavarika Island.  It looks to be about 90 feet long, and possibly a blue deck and a white hull. Found in OpenStreetMap on 1 January 2018.  US Coast Guard contacted.  Might be old or might be new.

osm_tags.description: The Robert Storrs Small Boat Harbor consists of 1,232 linear feet of floats, comprising 71 slips. Long-term slips and transient moorage spaces are available for vessels up to 60 feet. Potable water, shore-power, and refuse removal are available.
